posts.title: Lucy and Desi arrive at Idlewild
posts.summary: The just adopted Lucy and Desi (adopted from Mark and Sonja) arrived for their first day at my home on Idlewild Ave in Napa.
posts.body: The just adopted Lucy and Desi (adopted from Mark and Sonja) arrived for their first day at my home on Idlewild Ave in Napa.  They came from a family in Yountville who did not realize their adopted feral cat was pregnant.  Lucy and Desi are from a litter of five.  Desi was a little bigger than Lucy, Lucy was the smallest of the litter.

posts.title: Desi and shoe-mouse
posts.summary: Desi brought an injured mouse in again after midnight.  I trapped it and took it to Sierra Ct. park.
